description: List installed and running apps visible to the local Computer Use backend. Use the optional query to narrow Code Mode output while searching by app name or bundle identifier. Set include_windows true with a query matching exactly one running app to return bounded window-title inventory without reading AX state. Inventory does not grant an action binding.

include_windows.description: Return window titles for exactly one matching running app; requires query. No AX read or action binding is created.

query.description: Optional case-insensitive substring of an app name or bundle identifier.

name: list_apps

description: Request a background launch or reuse of one exact installed app. This invalidates any prior observation. Call get_app_state with the returned app name before performing an action. Choose one identity field and do not probe multiple aliases or repeat the launch before observing. The selected inventory row must expose a bundle_id; name-only rows fail before backend dispatch.

app.description: Exact installed app name or bundle identifier from list_apps.

bundle_id.description: Exact installed bundle identifier from list_apps.

name.description: Exact installed app name from list_apps.

name: launch_app

description: Observe one running app and retain a one-use internal action binding. Default ax_only returns the current AX tree without a screenshot. Choose full for AX plus screenshot, or screenshot_only for pixels without AX. Either visual mode may be requested immediately, for visual tasks or verification; no prior AX failure is required. When macOS reports that the exact window exists but its AX surface is unresolved, this may foreground that window once and retry the observation. AX-only observations never authorize screenshot coordinates. AX output defaults to automatic diffs: first a full tree, then smaller deltas against the last compatible public tree. Use disable_diffing true for a full tree after context loss or reconstruction uncertainty. An optional ax_tree_base selects an exact retained display base, never action authority.

app.description: Exact app name or bundle identifier.

ax_tree_base.description: Optional exact retained revision from ax_tree metadata. Omit for automatic base selection. Never combine with disable_diffing true or screenshot_only.

disable_diffing.description: Return a complete AX tree and reset the display base. Use true after losing the prior tree; omit or false for automatic diffs. True cannot accompany ax_tree_base or screenshot_only. Does not request a screenshot.

observation_mode.description: ax_only (default) returns only AX; full returns AX plus screenshot; screenshot_only returns only a screenshot. Choose a visual mode directly when the task needs pixels.

name: get_app_state

description: Click one element or screenshot coordinate from a fresh app observation. Use this direct action only for exactly one mutation, or when the next mutation depends on a fresh observation. For a fully determined sequence of two through twenty same-app mutations that needs no intermediate inspection, use batch_actions.

app.description: Exact app name or bundle identifier used by get_app_state.

x.description: X coordinate in the returned screenshot's normalized 0-1000 space, with origin at the top-left and positive X rightward.

y.description: Y coordinate in the returned screenshot's normalized 0-1000 space, with origin at the top-left and positive Y downward.

name: click

description: Invoke a supported secondary accessibility action exposed by an element. Use this direct action only for exactly one mutation, or when the next mutation depends on a fresh observation. For a fully determined sequence of two through twenty same-app mutations that needs no intermediate inspection, use batch_actions.

app.description: Exact app name or bundle identifier used by get_app_state.

name: perform_secondary_action

description: Scroll one observed accessibility element by whole pages. Use this direct action only for exactly one mutation, or when the next mutation depends on a fresh observation. For a fully determined sequence of two through twenty same-app mutations that needs no intermediate inspection, use batch_actions.

app.description: Exact app name or bundle identifier used by get_app_state.

pages.description: Whole pages to scroll. Defaults to 1.

name: scroll

description: Drag between two screenshot coordinates from a fresh observation. On macOS this briefly brings the target window to the foreground. Use this direct action only for exactly one mutation, or when the next mutation depends on a fresh observation. For a fully determined sequence of two through twenty same-app mutations that needs no intermediate inspection, use batch_actions.

app.description: Exact app name or bundle identifier used by get_app_state.

from_x.description: Start X coordinate in normalized 0-1000 screenshot space, with origin at the top-left and positive X rightward.

from_y.description: Start Y coordinate in normalized 0-1000 screenshot space, with origin at the top-left and positive Y downward.

to_x.description: End X coordinate in normalized 0-1000 screenshot space, with origin at the top-left and positive X rightward.

to_y.description: End Y coordinate in normalized 0-1000 screenshot space, with origin at the top-left and positive Y downward.

name: drag

description: Type literal text into the observed app. Use this direct action only for exactly one mutation, or when the next mutation depends on a fresh observation. For a fully determined sequence of two through twenty same-app mutations that needs no intermediate inspection, use batch_actions.

app.description: Exact app name or bundle identifier used by get_app_state.

name: type_text

description: Press one key or xdotool-style modifier chord in the observed app. Use this direct action only for exactly one mutation, or when the next mutation depends on a fresh observation. For a fully determined sequence of two through twenty same-app mutations that needs no intermediate inspection, use batch_actions.

app.description: Exact app name or bundle identifier used by get_app_state.

element_index.description: Optional target element index from get_app_state. Omit to retain app-scoped input.

key.description: Key or chord, for example Return or super+c.

name: press_key

description: Set one observed accessibility element's value. Confirmation covers the control value only, not application-level effects or saving. A field may need an explicit commit; verify the affected document or output, not just the input field. Use this direct action only for exactly one mutation, or when the next mutation depends on a fresh observation. For a fully determined sequence of two through twenty same-app mutations that needs no intermediate inspection, use batch_actions.

app.description: Exact app name or bundle identifier used by get_app_state.

name: set_value

description: Preferred default for two through twenty same-app mutations that are fully known from the current observation, even when the user did not request batching. Do not reproduce such a sequence with separate direct action calls. Supply the ordered list in actions, never steps. Run a checked sequence of at most twenty same-app mutations. The wrapper executes them serially, refreshes state after every dispatched mutation, records confirmed versus explicitly unverified effects, and stops on the first unsafe outcome. A screenshot-coordinate click or drag is allowed only as step zero. Call get_app_state for the app immediately before this tool; observation authority and resource limits remain host-owned.

actions.description: Closed same-app mutation sequence. Limits and deadline are owned by the host and cannot be widened by arguments.

x.description: X coordinate in the returned screenshot's normalized 0-1000 space, with origin at the top-left and positive X rightward.

y.description: Y coordinate in the returned screenshot's normalized 0-1000 space, with origin at the top-left and positive Y downward.

pages.description: Whole pages to scroll. Defaults to 1.

from_x.description: Start X coordinate in normalized 0-1000 screenshot space, with origin at the top-left and positive X rightward.

from_y.description: Start Y coordinate in normalized 0-1000 screenshot space, with origin at the top-left and positive Y downward.

to_x.description: End X coordinate in normalized 0-1000 screenshot space, with origin at the top-left and positive X rightward.

to_y.description: End Y coordinate in normalized 0-1000 screenshot space, with origin at the top-left and positive Y downward.

element_index.description: Optional target element index from get_app_state. Omit to retain app-scoped input.

key.description: Key or chord, for example Return or super+c.

app.description: Exact app name or bundle identifier used by the retained bounded observation.

name: batch_actions
